panic.title: Panic mode
panic.desc: Choose between 2 and 12 trigger inputs. Once triggered, the scooter locks down and requires the recovery code below to reactivate.

speed.title: Top speed
speed.desc: Configurable up to 127 km/h. Actual output is limited by rider weight.

start.title: Start speed
start.desc: Speed applied the moment throttle is engaged from a stop.

modes.title: Mode control
modes.desc: Set the maximum speed permitted in each ride mode.

wheelie.title: Wheelie optimizer
wheelie.desc: Automatically balances power delivery to help lift the front wheel and hold a stable wheelie.

soon.title: More coming soon
soon.desc: Additional tuning modules are in development and will unlock in a future release.

settings.title: Settings
settings.firmwareDesc: Region restrictions are bypassed automatically on every connection.
